optimizedContext.value:
# GetStatus

## Rules
- Input `name`; optional active-only `refreshImplementationTracking=true`; optional `ifModifiedSince`.
- Resolve active then draft; unknown throws `ChangeNotFoundError`. Draft projection read-only with no mutable lifecycle.
- Active: resolve schema, optionally refresh tracking, run sole reconciler, return committed aggregate plus artifacts, checks, blockers, approvals, verification, fingerprints, lifecycle, `changePath`.
- Schema failure returns read-only actionable `SCHEMA_RESOLUTION_FAILED`; after schema success propagate check/reconciliation failures.
- Conditional unchanged response occurs only after refresh/reconciliation.
- Run matching predicates for each legal candidate; archive predicates at `archivable`; never effects. Reuse task-check count.
- Core projects every schema artifact with DAG effective/display state, review/recovery, tracking files/links. CLI consumers must not recompute.
- Factory uses resolver and complete bootstrap dependencies.

## Constraints
- Only reconciler-selected validity effects may persist.
- Archived/draft/schema-unavailable reads stay read-only.
- `changePath` comes from `ChangeRepository.changePath(change)`.
